# The paths a pull request may change without a `Review:` line for its head (README.md,
# "Tests"): what programista-prosty may change (.claude/agents/programista-prosty.md, "You
# may change"), narrowed where its list is a judgement. Every other path is on the risk
# list, so a new folder starts there. The test fixtures are not here: one is the receiver
# the end-to-end test delivers to, the others are the agents the rules test must reject.
# CI reads this list from the pull request's base.
#
# One pattern a line: `dir/` matches everything below dir, `**/name` a file of that name in
# any folder, anything else one exact path. A `!` line is a risk path inside an exempt one
# and wins over it. tests/Repo/ReviewTrailTest.php pins the risk markers of
# tests/Repo/ClaudeRulesTest.php against this list.
README.md
docs/
!docs/contract.md
!docs/plugin-behaviour.md
!**/CLAUDE.md
